Messages.Author: Faethor
Messages.Body:
I just bought my first five packs of Sabbat cards. The price is
quite reasonable, but I'm not very amused at the amount of re-printed
cards. Out of five packs, 140 cards, 25 vampires, I got _47_ reprints -
a third. That's two packs of cards, san Vampires. Breaking it down a

little, I have 8 Master:Discipline cards, not ONE of which is for a new
discipline! It's about time that the discipline glyph is actually ON the
Master:Discipline card - nice touch, that.

I'm going to have to print the spoilers, and go through it carefully
before I make a decision on whether or not to invest much in additional
packs. Trading for the cards I want (initially, anyways) seems to be the
best, cheapest route to go..

I like the new clans, and the antitribu implementation. I look
forwards to building a Sabbat deck, trying out some of the new discipline
cards. Is Channeling the Beast the 'revised' Lucky Blow?

A thought.. Can I play a Clan Impersonation to switch from antitribu
and/or back? I don't see anything that would prohibit it..

-j

Messages.Author: David Hyatt
Messages.Body:
Faethor <fae...@winternet.com> writes:

> I like the new clans, and the antitribu implementation. I look
>forwards to building a Sabbat deck, trying out some of the new discipline
>cards. Is Channeling the Beast the 'revised' Lucky Blow?

It is very similar; Lucky Blow is free but you don't replace it
until after combat. Channeling the Beast costs the vampire 1 blood,
but you get to replace it immediately. Seems like a reasonable
card to me.

> A thought.. Can I play a Clan Impersonation to switch from antitribu
>and/or back? I don't see anything that would prohibit it..

I'm sure you can. The antitribu are essentially different clans, since
they have "clan"-specific cards that they can play...

Messages.Author: Pheersum

> >and/or back? I don't see anything that would prohibit it..
>
> I'm sure you can. The antitribu are essentially different clans, since
> they have "clan"-specific cards that they can play...

With Clan Impersonation you might switch from Toreador Antitribu to
Toreador, but would you switch from Sabbat to Camarilla? Yes, I know it
seems like only common sense from a V: the Masquerade point of view that
one couldn't mimick the Camarilla clan without mimicking the Camarilla
social nature. But in V:TES terms the Sabbat card text is not merely a
part of the Antitribu clan nature.
